item.title: Shiga's Sake Breweries: Lake Water, Mountain Rice — Guide
item.description: Shiga is one of Japan’s quietly excellent sake regions: more than 30 breweries work the prefecture, drawing soft water filtered through the mountains of the Lake Biwa watershed and rice from the fertile Omi plain, producing sake known for gentle umami depth that pairs naturally with the lake’s cuisine. Historic kura cluster around Otsu — where the brewery quarter near the old Tokaido road keeps its earthen storehouses — and in merchant towns like Hino and Harie, whose springs run so pure that households channel them through their kitchens, and many breweries open their doors for tastings, tours and seasonal fresh-pressed namazake.
